```{r}
library(sf)          # Spatial vector features
library(cluster)     # Hierarchical clustering (AGNES)
library(dendextend)  # Dendrogram untangling & entanglement metrics
library(ggplot2)     # Spatial visualization
library(gridExtra)   # Multi-panel layouts
```

```{r}
generate_city_data <- function(city_name, n_tracts = 80, policy_type = "exclusionary") {
  
  # Generate projected coordinates (UTM Zone 17N meters)
  # for a 20km x 20km city
  x_base <- ifelse(city_name == "Simpsonville", 500000, 550000)
  y_base <- 4000000
  
  x_coords <- runif(
    n_tracts,
    min = x_base,
    max = x_base + 20000
  )
  
  y_coords <- runif(
    n_tracts,
    min = y_base,
    max = y_base + 20000
  )
  
  # Create initial tract data frame
  tracts_df <- data.frame(
    city = city_name,
    tract_id = sprintf(
      "%s_T%03d",
      substr(city_name, 1, 3),
      1:n_tracts
    ),
    easting = x_coords,
    northing = y_coords
  )
  
  # Geographic gradient vector
  # (Southwest to Northeast axis)
  spatial_gradient <- 
    (x_coords - x_base) / 20000 + 
    (y_coords - y_base) / 20000
  
  spatial_gradient_norm <- 
    (spatial_gradient - min(spatial_gradient)) /
    (max(spatial_gradient) - min(spatial_gradient))
  
  # Generate socioeconomic variables
  if (policy_type == "exclusionary") {
    
    # SIMPSONVILLE:
    # Socioeconomics strictly follow geography
    # (Macro-Segregation)
    
    income_base <- 
      30000 + 
      75000 * spatial_gradient_norm + 
      rnorm(n_tracts, 0, 3000)
    
    college_base <- 
      10 + 
      65 * spatial_gradient_norm + 
      rnorm(n_tracts, 0, 2.5)
    
    unemp_base <- 
      14 - 
      10 * spatial_gradient_norm + 
      rnorm(n_tracts, 0, 0.8)
    
    rent_burden <- 
      60 - 
      35 * spatial_gradient_norm + 
      rnorm(n_tracts, 0, 1.8)
    
  } else if (policy_type == "inclusionary") {
    
    # SPRINGFIELD:
    # Mixed-income housing policy decouples
    # socioeconomic status from location
    
    random_noise <- runif(n_tracts, 0, 1)
    
    income_base <- 
      35000 + 
      20000 * spatial_gradient_norm + 
      50000 * random_noise
    
    college_base <- 
      15 + 
      15 * spatial_gradient_norm + 
      45 * random_noise
    
    unemp_base <- 
      12 - 
      3 * spatial_gradient_norm - 
      7 * random_noise
    
    rent_burden <- 
      55 - 
      10 * spatial_gradient_norm - 
      25 * random_noise
  }
  
  # Format Census variables
  tracts_df$med_income <- 
    round(pmax(18000, income_base), 0)
  
  tracts_df$pct_college <- 
    round(pmin(92, pmax(3, college_base)), 1)
  
  tracts_df$pct_unemp <- 
    round(pmin(25, pmax(1, unemp_base)), 1)
  
  tracts_df$pct_rent_burden <- 
    round(pmin(75, pmax(12, rent_burden)), 1)
  
  # Convert to sf object
  sf_city <- st_as_sf(
    tracts_df,
    coords = c("easting", "northing"),
    crs = 32617
  )
  
  return(sf_city)
}
```



```{r}
simpsonville <- generate_city_data(
  "Simpsonville",
  policy_type = "exclusionary"
)

head(simpsonville)
```

```{r}
springfield <- generate_city_data(
  "Springfield",
  policy_type = "inclusionary"
)

head(springfield)

```



```{r}  
# simulating fake data to model the theoretical income differences beased on the housing policies in Springfield and Simsponsville
  # Geographic gradient vector (Southwest to Northeast axis)
  spatial_gradient <- (x_coords - x_base)/20000 + (y_coords - y_base)/20000
  spatial_gradient_norm <- (spatial_gradient - min(spatial_gradient)) / 
                           (max(spatial_gradient) - min(spatial_gradient))
  
  if (policy_type == "exclusionary") {
    # SIMPSONVILLE: Socioeconomics strictly follow geography (Macro-Segregation)
    # High signal, low random spatial noise
    income_base    <- 30000 + 75000 * spatial_gradient_norm + rnorm(n_tracts, 0, 3000)
    college_base   <- 10 + 65 * spatial_gradient_norm + rnorm(n_tracts, 0, 2.5)
    unemp_base     <- 14 - 10 * spatial_gradient_norm + rnorm(n_tracts, 0, 0.8)
    rent_burden    <- 60 - 35 * spatial_gradient_norm + rnorm(n_tracts, 0, 1.8)
    
  } else if (policy_type == "inclusionary") {
    # SPRINGFIELD: Mixed-income housing policy decouples SES from location
    # Low spatial gradient dependence, high localized micro-variance
    random_noise <- runif(n_tracts, 0, 1)
    
    income_base    <- 35000 + 20000 * spatial_gradient_norm + 50000 * random_noise
    college_base   <- 15 + 15 * spatial_gradient_norm + 45 * random_noise
    unemp_base     <- 12 - 3 * spatial_gradient_norm - 7 * random_noise
    rent_burden    <- 55 - 10 * spatial_gradient_norm - 25 * random_noise
  }
  
  # Format Census variables
  tracts_df$med_income      <- round(pmax(18000, income_base), 0)
  tracts_df$pct_college     <- round(pmin(92, pmax(3, college_base)), 1)
  tracts_df$pct_unemp       <- round(pmin(25, pmax(1, unemp_base)), 1)
  tracts_df$pct_rent_burden <- round(pmin(75, pmax(12, rent_burden)), 1)
  
  # Convert to simple features sf object
  sf_city <- st_as_sf(tracts_df, coords = c("easting", "northing"), crs = 32617)
  return(sf_city)
}
```

```{r}
# Generate synthetic datasets for both policy regimes
simpsonville_sf <- generate_city_data("Simpsonville", n_tracts = 80, policy_type = "exclusionary")
springfield_sf  <- generate_city_data("Springfield",  n_tracts = 80, policy_type = "inclusionary")
```

```{r}
names(springfield_sf)
springfield_sp_dist <- dist(st_coordinates(springfield_sf))
simsponsville_sp_dist <- dist(st_coordinates(simpsonville_sf))
```

```{r}
# Compute hierarchical cluster for cities 
springfield_sp_agnes <- agnes(simpsonsville_sp_dist, method = "ward")
simsponsville_sp_agnes <- agnes(springfield_sp_dist, method = "ward")
```

```{r}
dend_simp <- as.dendogram(as.hclust(springfield_sp_agnes))
dend_spring <- as.dendogram(as.hclust(simpsonville_sp_agnes))
```
# Compute SES clustering 
```{r}
names(simpsonville_sf)
simpsonville_ses <- as.matrix(st_drop_geometry(simpsonville_sf)[, c("med_income"), "pct_college", "pct_unemp", "pct_rent_burden"])
simpsonville_ses <- scale(simpsonville_ses)
simpsonville_ses <- dist(simpsonville_ses)
```

```{r}
names(springfield_sf)
springfield_ses <- as.matrix(st_drop_geometry(springfield_sf)[, c("med_income"), "pct_college", "pct_unemp", "pct_rent_burden"])
springfield_ses <- scale(springfield_ses)
```


```{r}
dend_springfield_sp <- as.dendrogram(as.hclust(springfield_sp_agnes), na.rm=T)
dend_springfield_ses <- as.dendrogram(as.hclust(springfield_sp_agnes), na.rm="ward")
```

```{r}
dend_simpsonville_sp <- as.dendrogram(as.hclust(simpsonville_sp_agnes), na.rm="ward")
dend_simpsonville_ses <- as.dendrogram(as.hclust(simpsonville_sp_agnes), na.rm="ward")
```


```{r}
entang_val_springfield <- entanglement(untangle(springfield_ses_agnes, springfield_sp_agnes))
entang_val_simpsonville <- entanglement(untangle(springfield_ses_agnes, simpsonville_sp_agnes))
```


```{r}
 # Plot Tanglegram
tanglegram(
  untangle(dend_simpsonville_sp, dend_simpsonville_se),
  main_left = "Complete Linkage",
  main_right = "Ward's Method",
  highlight_distinct_edges = TRUE,
  common_subtrees_color_lines = TRUE,
  lwd = 1.2
  
tanglegram(
  untangle(dend_springfield_sp, dend_springfield_ses),
  main_left = "Complete Linkage",
  main_right = "Ward's Method",
  highlight_distinct_edges = TRUE,
  common_subtrees_color_lines = TRUE,
  lwd = 1.2
```

```{r}
entang_val <- entanglement(untangle(dend_simp, dend_spring),
                           highlight_distinct_edges = TRUE, 
                           common_subtrees_color_lines = TRUE, 
                           lwd = 1.2)
```
